title.narrative: Promotion of Press freedom, access to information and the Safety of journalists within the Framework of the Africa Media Convention Recommendations at AU and Ethiopia

description.narrative:
This workplan aims to strengthen an enabling environment for freedom of expression, press freedom, access to information, media development, and the safety of journalists in Ethiopia and across Africa in line with UNESCO's constitutional mandate, the Africa Media Convention (AMC) Recommendations, the UN Plan of Action on the Safety of Journalists and the Issue of Impunity, and relevant African Union and national frameworks. The intervention will support policy dialogue, multi-stakeholder engagement, capacity development, knowledge generation, and awareness-raising initiatives to promote independent, pluralistic, and safe media ecosystems.
The workplan will contribute to strengthening the capacities of journalists, media organizations, regulators, policymakers, civil society organizations, and other stakeholders to uphold freedom of expression and access to information, improve professional journalism standards, address emerging digital challenges, and promote the safety of journalists, particularly in the context of technological transformation and artificial intelligence.
